class.name: NetwDespawnConfig
class.brief_description: How every peer removes a node when it despawns, returned by [method Netw.configure_despawn].
class.description: Set in [method Object._init], and shared by every node of the same script. By default the node is freed at once. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_despawn(self) \ .before_removal(_play_death_vfx) \ .linger(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: before_removal
method.description: Calls the method of [param callable] on the entity root before it is removed, for example to play an effect. Only the method name is kept. Returns this config.

method.name: linger
method.description: Sets [member linger_seconds] and returns this config.

members.member: Seconds the node stays in the tree before it is freed, as [constant NetwMultiplayer.ENTITY_STATE_LINGERING]. [code]0.0[/code] frees it at once.
